Date Range Picker

Product·by @jeetnirnejak·2026-08-23·inspora page·original post

What it is

Date Range Picker: a Trip Dates card with CHECK-IN/CHECK-OUT fields over a month grid; picking dates paints endpoint pills and a rounded range band that grows with a wipe animation; preset chips (Weekend, 3 nights, 1 week, 2 weeks) auto-select matching ranges, each preset tinting the band its own color (blue, green, purple) with the night-count chip updating top-right.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-15%
Empty state: 'Add date' placeholders, September 2026 grid, preset row, Clear.
15-35%
Check-in picked (Sep 5 -> Sep 9 -> Sep 10): endpoint gets a filled circle; hovering a second date previews the range band (light fill) stretching across rows.
35-55%
Range complete (Sep 9-16, '7 nights' chip appears top-right in blue); band spans wrapped rows with pill-rounded ends; fields fill in.
55-75%
Wider range (Sep 10-24, '14 nights'); band colors stay blue; 'Pick check-out' hint when re-picking.
75-100%
Preset clicks: '3 nights' paints a green band (Sep 4-7, green '3 nights' chip); another preset paints purple; range re-colors and re-wipes to the new span.

Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: a date range picker - a Trip Dates card with CHECK-IN / CHECK-OUT fields over a month grid. Picking dates paints endpoint pills and a rounded range band that grows with a wipe animation; preset chips (Weekend, 3 nights, 1 week, 2 weeks) auto-select matching ranges, each tinting the band its own color (blue, green, purple), with the night-count chip updating top-right.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve, canvas/shader notes are perf guidance only; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Card: CHECK-IN / CHECK-OUT fields ("Add date" placeholders), September 2026 month grid, preset chip row, Clear button, night-count chip top-right when a range exists. Selected endpoints are filled circles; the range is a band spanning rows with pill-rounded ends.

## Motion spec
Pattern: two-tap range + preset recolor.
- Check-in picked: endpoint pops in (filled circle, scale 0.7 -> 1, 150ms spring); hovering a second date previews the band as a light fill stretching across rows.
- Range complete: band paints with a clip wipe (250ms ease-out, check-in -> check-out direction); fields fill; night-count chip appears top-right ("7 nights", tinted).
- Re-picking: "Pick check-out" hint state; band re-wipes to the new span.
- Preset tap: band re-colors (200ms crossfade to the preset's tint - blue/green/purple) and re-wipes to the preset's span; the chip takes the tint too.

## Calibration
- Band wipe 250ms in the direction of selection - the band grows from the anchor date, never appears whole.
- Endpoint pop 150ms spring; these two moments (pop + wipe) carry the whole interaction.
- Preset recolor is a crossfade of the band AND the chip together - one system, one color.

## Reduced motion
Band appears with a 150ms opacity fade; no wipe; endpoints without pop.

## Don't miss
- The hover preview band (light fill) before the second tap - this is what makes ranges feel discoverable.
- The band wraps rows with pill-rounded ends on partial rows; rectangular row fills look broken.
- Night-count chip text AND color always match the current selection/preset.
